title: MD5 use via Insecure.MD5.hash (swift) — review required
description: The swift call Insecure.MD5.hash computes MD5, which is broken for security purposes (collisions are practical). It is unacceptable for passwords, signatures, or integrity of untrusted data, but still fine for non-security checksums. This lexical rule cannot tell the use case — treat every hit as review-required.
remediation: Use SHA256.hash for any security purpose. Keep MD5 only for non-security checksums with a comment saying so.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches any Insecure.MD5.hash call regardless of purpose. Bare md5() calls belong to the generic rule; other weak algorithms are separate rules.
